headline: Magnolia Oil Q3 earnings beat estimates
summary: Magnolia Oil reported third-quarter earnings that surpassed analyst expectations by $0.12 per share, with revenue also exceeding forecasts.
why: Magnolia Oil & Gas is an independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company focused on the Eagle Ford Shale and Austin Chalk formations in South Texas.

impacts.name: Magnolia Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Earnings beat typically drives positive investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The earnings and revenue beat relative to market expectations generally leads to positive price action for the stock.
